tab_suite_powers_desc: Direct drop brushes and 1-click god actions for Wardens, Wolfkin, war heroes, mercenaries, imperial highways, citadels, tectonics, and multi-continent worlds.
tab_suite_rules_desc: 8 streamlined master toggles for CoreScale performance, Always Day, distinct kingdom borders, Live War Ticker, Warfare & Intel, Animal Kingdoms, Dense Cities & Infrastructure, and Co-Op Host.
suite_drop_wardens_description: Click anywhere on land to drop Sentinel Warden settlers who follow the peaceful Sleeping Giant doctrine (never start wars, 3-strikes grudge retaliation).
suite_drop_wolfkin_description: Click anywhere on land to drop 12 sapient Wolfkin ready to found their own wolf civilization.
suite_open_species_description: Open the ApexFactions panel to configure all 30 animal species, Sentinel Wardens, and Snake Mode.
suite_awaken_animals_description: Instantly grant sapience to all eligible wild animal subspecies across the entire map.
suite_open_war_monitor_description: Inspect active wars, war causes, top diplomatic opinion drivers, relations matrix, and Force Peace controls.
suite_armory_blessing_description: Click on a city or army to outfit nearby soldiers with high-tier forged weapons and armor.
suite_anoint_hero_description: Click near a unit or city to elevate a warrior into a legendary War Hero with boosted stats and elite gear.
suite_merc_drop_description: Click on land to drop a seasoned band of hired mercenaries fighting for the nearest kingdom.
suite_dispatch_spy_description: Infiltrate a covert agent from a rival kingdom into a stronger target capital to climb the court, stage a palace coup, and unite the realm peacefully.
suite_jump_battle_description: Pan the camera straight to the hottest ongoing combat clash or active war capital.
suite_build_infra_description: Construct wide cobblestone imperial highways between major friendly cities and build double-thick gated stone citadels around major capitals.
suite_fortify_now_description: Build gated stone and iron perimeter walls around all eligible large cities right away.
suite_bridges_now_description: Construct stone road causeways linking friendly coastal cities across narrow water straits.
suite_age_ruins_description: Fast-forward weathering on all fallen city ruins so walls crack and grow mossy and wild.
suite_pangaea_drift_description: Physically slide two halves of a continent apart across open ocean, carving a jagged sea and volcanic islets while carrying living units on their drifting plates.
suite_tectonic_rift_description: Open an organic widening ocean strait across any map without harming inland empires. Evacuates units to nearby dry shores and preserves inland cities and walls.
suite_gen_continent_description: Sculpt a brand-new pre-stitched multi-continent map right in-game with stepping-stone islands and starting settlers.
suite_dispatch_fleet_description: Queue soldiers from your strongest kingdom into the ocean portal to invade or reinforce another linked save.
suite_record_chronicle_description: Save a JSON history snapshot of all kingdoms, eras, and wars readable in WorldBox Studio.
suite_modern_advance_description: Promote the largest kingdom from Tier 1 blackpowder to Tier 2 armor/props or Tier 3 MBTs, jets, and SAMs.
suite_drop_armor_description: Click anywhere on land to deploy Main Battle Tanks and Light Tanks for the largest kingdom.
suite_drop_air_description: Click anywhere on the map to launch Supersonic Jets and Attack Helicopters for the largest kingdom.
suite_tog_turbo_description: Toggle aggressive FPS boost (shadow cull, animation culling, particle & flash reductions, staggered scans). Fine sliders available in F8.
suite_tog_always_day_description: Clear night, moon, ash, and storm darkness overlays client-side while keeping all World Age gameplay mechanics intact. Fine lighting & Age of Hope lock in F9.
suite_tog_borders_description: Automatically separate neighboring kingdom colors for instant map readability and sharpen territory borders. Fine visual controls in F9.
suite_tog_war_ticker_description: Show a compact, collapsible top-right war feed with causes, casualties, and 1-click Go jump buttons whenever wars are active.
suite_tog_warfare_suite_description: Master toggle for naval broadsides, coastal bombardment, blockades, supply lines, defense pacts, espionage, and alliance trade. Fine controls in F10.
suite_tog_warfare_suite_tip: Click to toggle · War Room: F10
suite_tog_auto_kingdoms_description: Automatically awaken wild animal packs over time to found sapient animal kingdoms. Manage all 30 species and Snake Mode in F12.
suite_tog_dense_cities_description: Master toggle for condensed dense city housing, wide imperial highways, fortified capital citadels, perimeter walls, and strait bridges. Fine controls in Alt+R.
suite_tog_coop_description: Start or stop the browser Co-Op God Console server and show your LAN URL + 4-digit PIN.
suite_tog_modern_auto_description: Kingdoms automatically advance across Tier 1 blackpowder, Tier 2 industrial, and Tier 3 modern tech.
